import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'

import { load } from '../../../../src/subject'

describe('vitest quality corpus', () => {
    test('vitest exact state', () => {
        expect(load()).toBe(2)
    })

    test('vitest empty masked case', () => {
        load()
    })

    test('vitest constant self proof', () => {
        expect(401).toBe(401)
    })

    test('vitest early return', () => {
        if (!process.env.FIXTURE_AVAILABLE) return
        expect(load()).toBe(2)
    })

    test('vitest cache name mismatch', () => {
        expect(load()).toBe(load())
    })

    test('vitest unreachable oracle', () => {
        if (false) expect(load()).toBe(2)
    })

    test('vitest uninformative measurement', () => {
        const elapsed = 0
        expect(elapsed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0)
    })
})
